item.title: This store is betting on your love life: it's giving away GTA 6 for free if your baby is born on launch day
item.description: A Norwegian store promised a free copy of GTA 6 to any customer whose child is born exactly on November 19, 2026. It's not a joke, and the campaign already went viral.
